title: Exactness of the concrete left-coefficient Cech sequences
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ morphisms of quasi-compact schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine diagonals. Let $S=(F_1\to F_2\to F_3)$ be a short exact sequence [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent] and let $G$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module. Choose the actual finite subcovers of the library affine covers, with open families $U$ on $X$ and $V$ on $Y$, and let $W_{ij}=\operatorname{pr}_1^{-1}U_i\cap\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V_j$ on $X\times_kY$. For a coefficient $F$, define $T(F)=\operatorname{Tot}(\check C(U,F)_k^{\mathrm{ext}}\otimes_k\check C(V,G)_k^{\mathrm{ext}})$, where scalar restriction is along the structure map and superscript ext means extension from natural to integer degrees by zero. Define $P(F)=\check C(W,\operatorname{pr}_1^*F\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G)_k^{\mathrm{ext}}$, with the external coefficient convention of [lem-sc-picard-external-cup-cochain]. Both constructions are functors in $F$, using coefficient maps on sections, signed tensor total maps, pullback and tensor maps. The two short complexes $T(S)$ and $P(S)$ are short exact. This asserts neither a cup comparison nor a cohomology isomorphism.

proof.text: The actual finite-subcover affine opens are affine. Express each categorical product of a nonempty finite tuple as its infimum, and use isAffineHom_diagonal_iff and InfClosed.iInf_mem_of_nonempty. Apply scalar affine section exactness to every tuple. Assemble a degreewise splitting by product projections and Pi.lift to prove scalar Cech short exactness.

Extension by zero is short exact degreewise: use extendXIso inside the embedding image and the zero-object splitting outside it. Each degreewise vector-space short exact sequence splits by splittingOfProjective. Tensor its section and retraction with the identity and extend through mapBifunctorDesc. Check the three splitting identities on each total summand with ι_mapBifunctorMap and ι_mapBifunctorDesc. This proves tensor-total short exactness without a new flat-tensor lemma.

A finite intersection of product-cover opens equals the rectangle formed by the factor intersections. These factor intersections are affine by the first step. Apply external affine rectangle exactness, then the same Cech product-splitting and extension-by-zero arguments. The existing zero-map instances use the proved tensorPullback adjunction to obtain additivity.
